title: 碳化矽牽引逆變器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

stages.title: 牽引與器件
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成牽引與器件；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete traction and devices through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 界定牽引工作區：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Bound traction operation: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解界定牽引工作區，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand bound traction operation through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「界定牽引工作區」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If bound traction operation disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「界定牽引工作區」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for bound traction operation, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 界定牽引工作區：證據
knowledge.text: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「碳化矽牽引逆變器」的「界定牽引工作區：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Bound traction operation: build the model” in “Silicon-carbide traction inverters”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

Peak power, continuous torque and regeneration must be specified separately.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

steps.observation: 把 DC 最大值、寄生過衝及不確定度分欄，標出待驗證設計裕度。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Separate maximum DC voltage, parasitic overshoot and uncertainty, marking margin for validation. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「核對額定與降額」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If check ratings and derating disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「核對額定與降額」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for check ratings and derating, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.
